title: Customer Delivery Architect
skills: plan, design, implement, and optimize (pdio) methodologies
teaser: Join our team as a Customer Delivery Architect, driving technical leadership and innovation within the Splunk security ecosystem. Lead the planning and delivery of tailored Splunk solutions, partnering with senior leaders to optimise threat detection and response. Ideal for experienced professionals with deep expertise in SIEM, SOAR, and AI-driven security operations.
description:
Meet the Team

You will join the Cisco Professional Services Security practice, a team of architects and consultants dedicated to helping enterprise customers increase their investment in Cisco’s security portfolio, specifically Splunk SIEM, SOAR, and AI-driven security operations. We handle projects from the initial discovery and design phases through to implementation and ongoing operations. We work closely with our product, engineering, and customer success teams to refine our delivery methods and internal tools, ensuring our customers get the best possible results from their security technology.

Your Impact

As a Splunk Security Architect, you will drive technical leadership and innovation within the Splunk security ecosystem, serving as a trusted advisor for sophisticated, multi-functional security initiatives at regional and global scale. You will lead the planning and delivery of tailored Splunk solutions—including SIEM, SOAR, and AI-driven security operations—that address critical customer security needs. You will partner with senior customer leaders to guide security adoption journeys, optimize threat detection and response, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value. Additionally, you will advocate for intellectual capital creation, synthesizing security trends to influence product direction and improve delivery methodologies.

Technical Leadership: Provide authority guidance within the Splunk security domain, exhibiting deep expertise in SIEM, SOAR, and Observability integrations.

Strategic Advisory: Lead sophisticated, multi-functional security projects, acting as a trusted partner to CISO and IT leadership.

Solution Delivery: Lead the strategic planning, compose, and implementation of tailored Splunk security architectures to mitigate risk and improve technology investments.

AI-Driven Security: Apply sophisticated AI and automation tools to optimize security operations, automate incident response, and improve detection efficacy.

Customer Management: Develop and maintain high-value relationships, ensuring technical alignment with customer security objectives.

Documentation Excellence: Define and implement documentation standards for sophisticated security deployments, ensuring transparency and structure for technical assets.

Authority Support: Build and apply advanced simulation environments; provide authority support for sophisticated security issues and platform challenges.

Mentorship & Growth: Build technical skills across the team, serving as a domain expert on Plan, Design, Implement, and Optimize (PDIO) methodologies.

Product Influence: Synthesize customer feedback to prioritize and advocate for Splunk product and service improvements.

Innovation: Apply expertise in security orchestration, automation, and AI Ops to deliver innovative, scalable customer outcomes.

Intellectual Capital: Lead the creation of digital assets, procedures, and standardized methodologies for Splunk security engagements.

multi-functional Partnership: Collaborate with Product Management to track security trends, influence service offers, and share actionable customer insights.

Minimum Qualifications

University degree plus equivalent experience (minimum 8+ years)

Expert-level certification in Splunk (e.g., Splunk Certified Architect, Splunk Certified Consultant) or equivalent relevant security certification.

Demonstrable experience in customer-facing advisory roles, including defining project scope, estimating effort, and drafting statements of work.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrable experience leading sophisticated, multi-functional consulting or engineering projects within the security space.

Deep technical expertise in the Splunk platform, with a demonstrated ability to drive security adoption and customer outcomes.

Advanced skills in automation, SOAR orchestration, and AI-driven security operations.

Demonstrable ability to mentor and develop talent across technical consulting teams.

Superb communication, collaborator management, and presentation skills, with experience representing technical expertise at industry events.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
